title: Mike McDaniel hopes to get QB Justin Herbert to "own the position" in a way he never has

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Mike McDaniel hopes to get QB Justin Herbert to "own the position" in a way he never has
sources.description: As quarterback Justin Herbert enters the seventh year of his career, the Chargers continue to hope to unlock a potential that has yet to be fully realized n the form of a single postseason win.
